quotes.text: Copilot saves moments, not money. It can summarize a meeting, draft a reply, or suggest the next step.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up why an assistant alone does not produce measurable ROI.

quotes.text: Always register these connectors at the environment or solution level, not per user. Otherwise you create a nightmare of duplicated connectors, inconsistent authentication, and no centralized management.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete governance rule for deploying custom connectors.

quotes.text: Adaptive cards repair that human bottleneck by planting the act button directly where people already are: Teams, Outlook or even Loop. They convert ideas into executable objects.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains how Adaptive Cards turn Copilot suggestions into in-place actions.

quotes.text: Think of DLP as the immune system for your copilot ecosystem. Copilot generates ideas, power automate executes them, and DLP ensures neither leaks sensitive material.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear metaphor for the role of DLP policies in AI-driven automation.

quotes.text: Parallelism is the antidote: multiple branches executing simultaneously, each handling a slice of data, so the whole pipeline finishes before lunch instead of after dinner.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable explanation of why concurrency matters for high-volume flows.

Custom connectors: giving Copilot real context
Adaptive Cards: turning suggestions into actions
DLP enforcement: guarding against data leaks

takeaways: Copilot only produces measurable ROI when its suggestions are wired into governed Power Automate workflows.
Custom connectors and Adaptive Cards give Copilot access to internal systems and let users act directly in Teams or Outlook, while DLP policies keep data inside approved connectors.
Concurrency control speeds up high-volume flows within API limits, and telemetry from tools like Application Insights or Purview turns time savings into evidence.
hook: Copilot can summarize and suggest, but on its own it saves moments, not money. This episode is for Power Platform makers and admins who need to show real ROI from AI. You will learn five Power Automate techniques, from custom connectors and Adaptive Cards to DLP, concurrency and telemetry, that turn Copilot ideas into governed, measurable automation.
